records.name: 215 Live Entertainment
records.summary: A Philadelphia performing arts group that teaches acting, dance, and voice to young people and adults, and stages shows about real social issues.
records.what_you_do: Take a class in acting, dance, or voice, or audition for the youth companies. Audiences can see the shows listed on the events page.

first_step.how: Call 267-251-1156 or use the Education Registration form on the site to sign up for a class or youth company.
first_step.basis: Classes and youth companies are open to the public with a clear sign up path, but the page shows no class schedule.

records.notes: Events are listed (Rock'n the 215 Artist Showcase, Murder Mystery Dinner, The 215 Trilogy Fest) but the page gives no dates, so status is based on a working site with no dates. Cost and email not found.

records.name: 5 Shorts Project
records.summary: A Philadelphia film group that helps local residents make their own films, with no experience needed, and runs a teen film festival.
records.what_you_do: Learn filmmaking through the Learn Filmmaking and teen program pages, make a short with the group, or buy tickets to the Teen Film Fest.

first_step.how: Join the monthly newsletter on 5shorts.org, then open the Learn Filmmaking page to find the next class.
first_step.basis: The group says no experience is needed and has a teen and youth track, but no class dates were visible.

records.notes: Teen Film Fest on Saturday July 25, 2026 is the newest dated item. Fiscally sponsored through CultureTrust Greater Philadelphia. Cost of classes not found.

records.name: A Forbidden Fruit
records.summary: A creative wellness group that runs free events, a community giving garden, and a festival that mixes art with health and connection.
records.what_you_do: Come to the free Root 2 Fruit Festival, help with the Giving Garden, or join the Harvest Hub newsletter for upcoming programs.

cost.text: Root 2 Fruit Festival is listed as free

first_step.how: Sign up for the Harvest Hub newsletter on the site, then come to the free Root 2 Fruit Festival on Sept 12, 2026 from noon to 6 pm.
first_step.basis: Festival and garden events are free and public, and the site asks for a simple newsletter sign up.

records.notes: Newest items are the Root 2 Fruit Festival FAQ (Sep 2) and a festival thank you note. Two blog posts say only 7 days ago, with no exact date. Costs of other events not found. Contact page exists but no email was visible.

records.name: Actívate Stories
records.summary: A group that makes community documentaries, shares local media, and holds public film screenings in Philadelphia.
records.what_you_do: Attend a free or donation screening, sign up for updates, or check the Opportunities page to take part in a film project.

first_step.how: Sign up for the email list on the site to hear about the Oct 9, 2026 Bok Open Studios and upcoming screenings.
first_step.basis: Screenings and events are public and there is a clear email sign up, though no registration steps are given.

records.notes: Dated events on the site: Bok Open Studios Oct 9, 2026; Fitler Club screening Nov 6, 2026; Artcinia event Nov 7, 2026; Storyville Philly Rumba Feb 19 to 28, 2027. Event locations and ticket prices not found. The Cultural Justice Project site is marked relaunching soon.

records.name: All Around This World
records.summary: An online music and dance curriculum for children that is sold as a paid subscription.
records.notes: Business with paid plans and a teacher certification product. No free or local community program found and no Philadelphia connection on the site, so it is not a Philadelphia group. Newest post Oct 5, 2026.

records.name: Almanac Projects
records.summary: A dance, circus, and theater company in Philadelphia that makes shows, runs festivals, and offers free hands on workshops.
records.what_you_do: Sign up for a free Helpful Hints Workshop, buy a ticket to a show, or join the mailing list to hear about new projects.

cost.text: Helpful Hints Workshops are free. Shows vary, for example Body as an Archive is $23.

first_step.how: Fill out the Airtable form linked on the site to sign up for the next free Helpful Hints Workshop at Pig Iron Theatre Company, Studio A.
first_step.basis: Workshops are free and open to the public with a sign up form, but the page does not say that beginners are welcome.

records.notes: Dated events: Helpful Hints Workshops Oct 19 and Oct 25, 2026 at Pig Iron Theatre Company; Body as an Archive at NAMBA in Ventura CA on Oct 16 (not Philadelphia); I Think It Could Work at Washington University in St. Louis on Oct 17 (not Philadelphia). Classes (AlmanAcro) and volunteer roles not found. Press reviews are undated.

records.name: Amber Art and Design
records.summary: A mural and public art studio that takes commissions and sells its work.
records.notes: Commercial studio: the site offers custom quotes, donations and a shop. No class, membership, volunteer or public program was found. The site's newsletter form says it needs a storage option, so it may not work. Revisit if they publish workshops or volunteer roles.

records.name: American Swedish Historical Museum
records.summary: A museum in South Philadelphia that shares Scandinavian history and culture through exhibits, events, classes, and volunteer work.
records.what_you_do: Visit the exhibits, come to an event or the Centennial Gala, take a family or adult education program, or volunteer through the Support page.

schedule.text: Open Tuesday to Sunday, 10 am to 4 pm

first_step.how: Visit during open hours, or fill in the volunteer form on the Support page to help with events and the collection.
first_step.basis: Public museum with a visible volunteer and membership page, though the steps are not spelled out.

records.notes: The ASHM Centennial Gala is on Oct 17; the page does not state the year, and the museum's centennial makes 2026 the likely year. Swedish cooking and language classes appear only as newsletter options, so availability is not confirmed. Admission cost not found. Email not found; contact page is /about/staff.

records.name: Applied Mechanics
records.summary: An immersive theater company in Philadelphia that makes plays about big social change, often with audiences moving through the set.
records.what_you_do: Buy a ticket to a show, join the mailing list, or support the company. The Workshops page is listed but its details were not visible.

first_step.how: Buy a ticket to Run Ben Run (Oct 6 to 18, 2026, at Christ Church Neighborhood House) through the Ticketleap link, or join the mailing list from the Contact page.
first_step.basis: Shows are public and sold online, and there is a mailing list, though the page does not describe how to join the company.

records.notes: The site lists Instagram, Vimeo, Facebook and Patreon but shows no full handles, so no social links were recorded. Run Ben Run venue address not given. Ticket prices not found.

records.name: ArcheDream for Humankind
records.summary: A touring blacklight mask and dance theater company that makes shows for all ages, teaches workshops, and runs a summer camp with scholarships.
records.what_you_do: See a show such as WEIRDOFEST, book a performance or workshop through the contact form, or support the MoveMakers summer camp scholarships.

first_step.how: Come to WEIRDOFEST at Philadelphia Brewing on Oct 17 (2 to 10 pm), or use the contact form on the site to ask about the MoveMakers summer camp or a workshop.
first_step.basis: Shows are public and there is a contact form, but no class sign up or membership steps were found.

records.notes: The WEIRDOFEST date (Oct 17) gives no year on the page; the copyright notice says 2026, so the event is probably 2026. Whether the company is based in Philadelphia is unclear: it is described as touring, and the phone number is a 610 area code. Admission cost not found. The summer camp fundraiser is undated.

records.name: Arthur Ross Gallery
records.summary: A free art gallery at the University of Pennsylvania that shows exhibitions and hosts artist talks and tours open to the public.
records.what_you_do: Visit the gallery for free, come to an artist talk, join a group tour, or become a Friend of the gallery.

schedule.text: Open Monday to Thursday 11 am to 6 pm, and Friday to Sunday noon to 5 pm. Artist talks Oct 9 and Oct 22, 2026.

locations.label: Gallery in Fisher Fine Arts Library

first_step.how: Walk in during open hours, or come to the free Artist Talk with Eileen Neff on Oct 22, 2026.
first_step.basis: Free and public with posted hours and talks, though it is a university gallery and class details were not visible.

records.notes: Dated events: Penn Art Collection Artist Talk Oct 9, 2026; Artist Talk Eileen Neff Oct 22, 2026. Class schedules under Learn (Engaging Minds Through Art, group tours) are not detailed. Front desk phone 215.898.1479.

records.name: ArtPhilly
records.summary: A Philadelphia arts group of creators across many art forms that puts on a city wide arts festival with projects in venues around the city.
records.what_you_do: Buy a ticket to a festival project, browse the project list, or sign up for the newsletter to hear about the next festival.

first_step.how: Sign up for the newsletter on artphilly.org and follow the Instagram page, then watch for the next festival listing.
first_step.basis: Festival events are public, but the page shows no class, membership or volunteer path, only a newsletter.

records.notes: What Now 2026 festival ran May 27 to July 2, 2026; newest dated item is Salonish: BYOI on June 30, 2026. Ticket prices not found. The listed email is for press (via ALMA communications). No festival dates after July 2 were shown.

records.name: ARTZ Philadelphia
records.summary: A nonprofit that runs arts programs for people living with dementia, their care partners, and the community, including museum visits and caregiver cafes.
records.what_you_do: Join an ARTZ program as a person living with dementia or as a care partner, volunteer, or join the board.

first_step.how: Choose a program under Participate on the site, such as ARTZ Connect online or ARTZ at The Museum in person, or join the mailing list.
first_step.basis: Programs are open to people with dementia and their care partners with a clear list, though the sign up steps were not shown.

records.notes: Newest dated item: director named PA Humanities Council 2026 Window Keeper (July 21, 2026). Gala on Nov 5, 2026. Event calendar dates not found and program cost not found.

records.name: Aurora Classical
records.summary: A Philadelphia group that brings classical singers and instrumentalists to the public, often at low cost, and holds open mics where anyone can play.
records.what_you_do: Come to the Classical Open Mic Matinee to hear or perform, go to a low cost concert, or volunteer for the monthly grocery bag pop up.

cost.text: Some concerts are pay what you wish; open mic admission not found

schedule.text: Classical Open Mic Matinee on Oct 17, 2026 at 4:30 pm. Grocery bag pop up on the second Monday of each month.

first_step.how: Come to the Classical Open Mic Matinee on Oct 17 at 4:30 pm, or email admin@auroraclassical.org to ask about playing or volunteering.
first_step.basis: Open mic is open to any classical performer and a pianist is provided, but beginners are not specifically mentioned.

records.notes: Recent dated events: Black Voices in American Art Song (Sept 10, 2026, Philly Fringe), Fall Arts Fest performance (Sept 19, 2026). Mailing address is c/o CultureTrust. Phone not found.

records.name: AUTOMAT Collective
records.summary: An artist run gallery in the Crane Arts Building that shows invited exhibitions and hosts free zinemaking workshops and book launches.
records.what_you_do: Visit on a Saturday for the exhibition, RSVP for the free Print and Play zinemaking workshop on Oct 10, or come to a book launch.

cost.text: Zinemaking workshop is free; RSVP required

schedule.text: Gallery open Saturdays noon to 5 pm or by appointment. Print and Play workshop Oct 10, 2026, 4 to 7 pm.

locations.label: Gallery in Crane Arts Building, Suite 105

first_step.how: RSVP through the Eventbrite link for the free Print and Play zinemaking workshop on Oct 10, 2026, 4 to 7 pm.
first_step.basis: The workshop is free and public with an RSVP, though the page does not say beginners are welcome.

records.notes: Dated events: If-When opening reception Oct 8, 2026; Print and Play Oct 10; book launch Nov 12; exhibition closes Nov 21, 2026. The site lists the email with (at) and (dot) spelling, written here as published. The address says ZIP 19125 while one footer says 19122; check before publishing. Copyright footer says 2025, which is not evidence.

leads_only.name: NAMBA Performing Arts Space
leads_only.note: Named as the ticket and venue link for a show on the Almanac Projects site (Ventura, CA). Not Philadelphia, not checked.

leads_only.name: Pig Iron Theatre Company
leads_only.note: Host of the Almanac Projects Helpful Hints Workshops. No verified URL, so not checked.

leads_only.name: CultureTrust Greater Philadelphia
leads_only.note: Fiscal sponsor of 5 Shorts Project, named on its site. No verified URL, so not checked.

notes: 18 groups in batch, all with a website, so no WebSearch was used (0 of 2). 18 WebFetch calls on the home pages only; no second page fetches. Verdicts: 16 publish, 2 not_a_group (All Around This World: paid online curriculum business; Amber Art and Design: commercial mural studio with no public program found). Statuses: active for 5 Shorts, Forbidden Fruit, Actívate, Almanac, ASHM, Arthur Ross, ArtPhilly, ARTZ, Aurora, AUTOMAT and Applied Mechanics; probably_active for 215 Live and ArcheDream; unknown for Artcinia, Art-Reach and Batikh Batikh. Items to check before publishing: Applied Mechanics social handles were not visible; AUTOMAT ZIP conflicts (19125 vs 19122); ArcheDream's WEIRDOFEST year and Philadelphia base are unclear; Artcinia's Philadelphia link is unverified. Two leads_only entries have no verified URL and are listed by name only.
